senses.zh_definition: Jaggu：人名或昵称，在马来语文本中可作为专有名词出现；尚未核实其具有马来语普通词义。
senses.en_definition: Jaggu, a personal name or nickname occurring in Malay-language text; no Malay common-word meaning has been verified.
senses.ms_definition: Nama orang atau nama panggilan yang muncul dalam teks bahasa Melayu; makna sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu belum disahkan. Huraian ini bukan takrif rasmi DBP.
senses.nuances: 按专有名词处理，通常写作 Jaggu。马来语字幕中的人物自称 Jaggu，并将其解释为 Jagat Janani 的简称；这不能证明它是马来语普通词，也不能确定输入词频的来源。[马来语字幕实例](https://subdl.com/id/s/info/l9dGzlrFI0/pk)。以下搭配和例句为编写的用法示例，未经高频语料验证；本条不具备标记为 official 的证据。

etymology.historical_story: In Malay subtitles for the film PK, Jaggu is presented as a character’s nickname, shortened from Jagat Janani after classmates mocked the longer name. This illustrates how a foreign personal name can appear repeatedly in Malay dialogue without becoming an ordinary Malay word. The supplied packet does not establish whether this film explains the frequency ranking or provide evidence of a Malay etymology. [Malay subtitle example](https://subdl.com/id/s/info/l9dGzlrFI0/pk).

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 用于指称名叫 Jaggu 的人或角色。不要把该名字当作可泛称某族群的称呼，也不要根据名字推断当事人的宗教、国籍或性别。
